scripts.build: npm run build:js && npm run build:css
scripts.build:css: sass --style=compressed --no-source-map --quiet-deps css/styles.scss:css/styles.css && purgecss --css css/styles.css --content index.html js/scripts.js js/vendor/bootstrap.bundle.min.js --safelist show showing hiding collapsing collapsed active fade modal-backdrop modal-open modal-static --output css/
scripts.build:js: node -e "const fs = require('fs'); fs.mkdirSync('js/vendor', {recursive: true}); for (const f of ['bootstrap.bundle.min.js', 'bootstrap.bundle.min.js.map']) fs.copyFileSync('node_modules/bootstrap/dist/js/' + f, 'js/vendor/' + f)"
